name: role
wording: a function an agent performs in a team, stated as a default value for every factor: one role per agent, so whoever dispatches it knows what comes back; it carries who the agent is, what it decides and what it is accountable for, never the steps of a workflow, which are method.
reason: Discovery 2026-10-10: keeps the canon's role-as-bundle and singular arity; the canon's roles carried the old workflow's procedure and could not outlive it.
